title: ACP/UCP Product-Feed Conformance Auditor
description: Validate a product or checkout JSON payload against ACP (AP2) and UCP spec fields. Returns gap list, fix checklist, and Policy Mandate export. Deterministic schema validation. Client-side, zero PII.
